about: Screenshot targets per calibration key, measured from daylight screenshots by the docs/map/calibration.md section 31 method (median sRGB over the top 60% of L per box, then OKLab L x0.95 capped at 0.86, C x0.9). 'ratio' targets are a measured ratio applied to another key's. 'alt' readings are other measurements of the same material, kept but not scored. 'tolerance' is the OKLab distance x100 a derived colour may lie from the target: default_tolerance unless the key names its own, which is shrink-only and set at its measured distance plus 1. A null tolerance is not scored.
